characterList.description: A young Asian male with silver and black hair, wearing glasses, a blue bucket hat, a yellow t-shirt at the beginning, and a gray t-shirt towards the end.
characterList.name: Frederic Chen

content_metadata.description: Frederic Chen shares his process of building a portfolio website using Wix, detailing the customization and design decisions along the way.

qAndA.answer: Frederic's favorite color is yellow, and he uses a pale yellow shade for the background of his website.
qAndA.question: What is Frederic's favorite color, and how does he incorporate it into his website?

qAndA.answer: Frederic avoids using bold and italic fonts together, comparing it to wearing a belt with overalls.
qAndA.question: What design rule does Frederic emphasize when choosing fonts for his website?

qAndA.answer: Frederic decides to merge his nature photography with his portrait photography on a single page because he only has a few nature photos he's satisfied with.
qAndA.question: Why does Frederic delete the "nature" page from his website?

qAndA.answer: Frederic finds it challenging to fit all of his content on the smaller screen of a mobile phone.
qAndA.question: What challenges does Frederic face when designing the mobile version of his website?

qAndA.answer: Frederic creates the drop shadow effect by grouping two identical text elements, offsetting them slightly, and making the top layer white.
qAndA.question: How does Frederic achieve the drop shadow effect on his website's headings?

activities.description: Talking to the camera and introducing himself.
Explaining why he needs a website.

activities.description: Showing the Wix website and highlighting its features.

Screen recording of the Wix website

activities.description: Selecting a website template and customizing it with his own content.
